interactive.reason: Native automated control input and engine captures; no separate hardware-controller or live desktop driving session.

limits: Authored vehicle reconstructions remain below production racing-game art quality; no OEM CAD accuracy claim.
Only Slate Rim is verified as a complete continuous route; other routes and full loop traversal remain unproven.
No long-session stability or controller-hardware test.
Earlier candidate full run was stopped for a scenery material correction and is not accepted evidence.
